snippet.title: Out Fishing - Psychological Fishing Horror Sim | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3660260/Out_Fishing/
Build your camp. Upgrade your tools. Catch that fish. Just watch out for the horrors that surround the lake. 

Demo coming March 18th. Add Out Fishing on Steam to get notified of the demo launch.
